high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a dressing room or changing area. The individual is wearing a light blue denim shirt with rolled-up sleeves, light-colored jeans, and dark shoes. They have a beard and short hair. The person is holding a smartphone in their right hand, which they are using to take the photo. The setting includes a white door with a silver handle and a small hook rack above it, which has no items hanging on it. To the right of the door, there is a white cabinet with a light switch panel below it.
